title: The Lion and the Goat
summary: A hungry lion pacing below a sheer limestone precipice looked up and saw a nimble mountain goat browsing sweet thyme upon a high crag....
full_text:
A hungry lion pacing below a sheer limestone precipice looked up and saw a nimble mountain goat browsing sweet thyme upon a high crag.

The lion called out with sweet, coaxing words: "Come down, fair goat! The rocks above are steep and perilous; you might slip and fall. The meadow down here is full of clover, cool brooks, and rich grass!"

The goat looked down from her secure perch and replied: "The grass below may be sweet, Master Lion, but you invite me down not that I may dine upon your meadows, but that you may dine upon me!"
moral: Beware the friendly invitations of predators whose interest is their own belly.
